text: Artificial intelligence is quickly changing the modern workplace. Automation now handles many repetitive tasks, which saves time and reduces errors. Productivity tools powered by AI help employees organise their work, write emails, and analyse data faster. However, AI is not replacing people completely. Instead, human-AI collaboration is becoming more common, as workers use smart systems to support their decisions. This shift also brings job changes. Some roles may disappear, while new ones appear, such as AI trainers and data specialists. To succeed, employees need to learn new skills and adapt to working alongside intelligent machines.
